school.school_name: 日本大学松戸歯学部附属歯科衛生専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a target-looking support PDF on a school information page and keep it review-bound when the year is unclear.
search_queries: 日本大学松戸歯学部附属歯科衛生専門学校 高等教育 修学支援
日本大学松戸歯学部附属歯科衛生専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Open the school information page under /college/info/purpose.html.
Locate the 高等教育の修学支援新制度 section.
Open the PDF anchor labeled 機関要件確認申請書様式第2号関係.
Verify the PDF body contains the school name and 様式第２号.
Queue the candidate for operator review because the PDF URL is stable and yearless.

reusable_rules: Inspect pages under /college/info/ for 高等教育の修学支援新制度 anchors.
Keep query strings on stable PDF URLs when they are part of the published link.
Route yearless higher_education_support PDFs to operator review after target-form body verification.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a stable PDF URL is current-year evidence.
Do not treat adjacent 学校関係者評価 PDFs as equivalent candidates.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the school information page anchor and verified the PDF body contains 日本大学松戸歯学部附属歯科衛生専門学校 and 様式第２号.
